name: stage_1_stand_permissive
description: Permissive standing stage — full legacy reward density so brain bootstraps standing pose without competing pressures.  Auto-advance after 30 sec CUMULATIVE upright (1800 ticks @ 60Hz).  standing_baseline_factor=1.0 + gated_walk_bonus_rate=0 preserves byte-identical behaviour vs the legacy stand_walk_distance curriculum during this stage.

name: stage_2_walk_multiplicative_gate
description:
Phase 7.5.R terminal stage — multiplicative-gating reward shape (Option 2).

  standing_baseline_factor = 0.25  ⇒ pure-standing density = 0.20 × 0.25 = 0.05 hits/tick.
                                     Standing alone is still rewarded (~25% of legacy), so cold-start pose isn't lost,
                                     but it's no longer the dominant attractor.
  walk_hit_rate            = 0.05  ⇒ legacy radial-walk channel kept at modest density (back-compat with current
                                     stand_walk_distance curriculum) so brains trained under either curriculum
                                     transition consistently.
  gated_walk_bonus_rate    = 0.20  ⇒ NEW channel: chassis_y_norm × v_norm × 0.20 hits/tick.  Fires densely when
                                     brain is BOTH upright AND moving radially outward; fails closed if either
                                     condition isn't met.  At full upright + full target velocity → 0.20 hits/tick
                                     bonus, matching legacy standing density.

Reward regime totals (hits/tick at the three regimes):
  standing only:                   0.05 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.05  (¼ legacy standing density)
  standing + radial walking:       0.05 + 0.05 + 0.20 = 0.30  (1.5× legacy standing density)
  walking without standing (fall): 0.00 + 0.00 + 0.00 = 0.00

Reward gradient: 6× between standing-only and standing+walking.  Multiplicative coupling ensures the bonus
stream can ONLY be earned by doing both at once — brain can't farm one channel to ignore the other.

Phase 7.14: fail_tilt_rad raised to 1.4 rad (~80°) from default 60°. User UI observation (seed=50, cruse_v2, 24min) found 58 tipover events — the reward-landscape CLIFF at 60° prevented walking-tilt from earning reward. Body learned 'don't lean' and stalled near origin. Raising to 80° gives 30% more tilt headroom for forward locomotion before catastrophe.

Phase 7.16: continuous level-chassis bonus (UNGATED).
  level_chassis_rate=0.03 (was 0.05 in stage_1, slightly reduced for walking)
  level_chassis_tilt_scale=π/2 (zero reward at 90° tilt)
Bonus fires EVERY tick regardless of fall state — gives body a continuous
gradient back to upright even when fallen/tipped over.  Composes additively
with standing/walking/gated rewards.

Phase 7.18: relaxed auto_reset to prevent transient-faceplant teleports.
  auto_reset_tilt_threshold = 2.5 rad (~143°, was 120° default)
  auto_reset_dwell_ticks    = 90 (1.5s @60Hz, was 30 = 0.5s)
Body must be CATASTROPHICALLY tilted AND on floor for 1.5s before reset.
Lets aggressive forward walking with transient faceplants self-recover
rather than teleport back to origin (Phase 7.14 Stage 3 finding: end_distance
regressed −1.03σ under tilt80 because aggressive walking triggered too many
auto_resets).

Phase 7.21 — combines locomotion improvements with progress-PB reward.
walk_reward_mode='to_target' + walk_over_there target_mode=random_pyramid
progress_reward_gain=50.0 (PB-only reward, v2 fix: chassis_y_norm>0.9 gate + multiplicative scaling)
gated_walk_bonus_rate halved to 0.10 since progress reward provides approach signal
Body must close distance-to-target to earn progress reward; reward gradient is
DIRECTIONAL, not just velocity-based. Combined with tilt80 + level_chassis + closed-loop
smooth_fallback + auto_reset_relaxed, this is the full Phase 7.21 stack.
